protocol.fixture: bench/zx_compare.zi Answer with the host_api Input bound to seed, rounds and kind; kind 1 mixes a 32-cell struct workload
protocol.warmup: the helper warms at least 500 ms before its measured batches
protocol.engine: per-entry ms = warm batch wall / batches; checksum verified for every measured batch
protocol.native_cold: one fresh helper process per sample; cold ms = load + instantiate + first entry
protocol.native_warm: per-entry ms = warm batch wall / batches from the same fresh process
protocol.aot: whole-process wall of the zx2native ELF, startup included, base seed only
protocol.zi2c: The same scalar and record algorithm emitted by zi2c and compiled with cc -O2; runtime seed, rounds and kind; in-process timing, backend none. The ZX entry obtains its three inputs through host calls.
protocol.order: fixed interleaving per trial and kind: engine, native, zi2c, aot
protocol.outliers: symmetric 1.5 x IQR excluded; raw samples retained
